card.title: Director of Operations, Service Delivery
card.description:
**About LawnStarter**

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, spanning three brands: LawnStarter, Lawn Love, and Home Gnome. We've cleared $750M in bookings and turned a profit three years running. Founded in Austin in 2013, we're a team of about 180 that scales past 500 employees during peak season. The marketplace itself is easy to describe and hard to run well: a customer requests a service, we price the job and match it to an eligible Pro, the Pro claims and completes the work, and we process payment and take a commission.

We're entering the most ambitious stretch in the company's history as we build new verticals, new software products, and the groundwork to become a multi-billion-dollar company.

One of our company values is AI or Extinction: every task, AI-first. No exceptions, no excuses. Top 1% or we're already a fossil. This role is hired against that bar.

**The Role**

This is a biz ops generalist role, built for someone who wants to work across many parts of the business instead of owning one narrow lane. You'll start as an individual contributor with no direct reports, in a new seat reporting directly to the COO. Your first owned area will be building Service Delivery into a working operational function. This will entail adding structure, visibility and process to the way we ensure as many customer jobs as possible are completed successfully and on time by LawnStarter Pros, in lawn care and other services we offer now and over time.

New projects will show up unscoped over time. That's by design. As LawnStarter enters new verticals and grows toward a multi-billion-dollar future, big problems will keep surfacing with no obvious owner, and you'll be one of the people the COO trusts to run them down.

**What makes this role different:**

* You work on some of the biggest company-wide projects, cutting across teams and functional areas.
* You'll be a top builder in Brain, LawnStarter's internal AI toolkit built on Claude Code that already powers everything we do across the company: metric queries, document drafting, bug triage, and more. We expect you to approach your work in an AI-first fashion, leveraging Brain to build new systems and processes that will push the limits of how fast AI can accelerate business results. Every project you run is built AI-first: the analysis, the tooling, the process automation, the monitoring. You build it yourself instead of waiting on an analyst or engineer.
* You own outcomes end to end, from recommendation through execution. Strategy without follow-through doesn't count here.

**What You'll Own**

* **Service Delivery, from the ground up.** Despite LawnStarter's considerable scale and reach, Service Delivery doesn't exist yet as a dedicated function. You'll help define the standards we should meet for job completion rates and speed, measure whether we hit them, and design processes, incentives and real-time interventions that get tested with Pros and customers in the field to lift performance. Scope covers every vertical and every delivery model, from today's 1099 Pros to potential W-2 crews under future evaluation.
* **Raising customer & Pro retention rates.** When we deliver service with excellence, Pros and customers alike stay with us longer. Working tightly with peers across Product, Data and Support, you'll identify new opportunities for us to boost retention and LTV and play a key role in driving resulting initiatives cross-functionally.
* **Whatever comes next.** New projects will land on your plate as the company grows into new verticals and builds new software products. You'll take them from "we should look into this" to building and then running systems with structure, KPIs and owners.

**Problems to Solve**

**Build a Service Delivery function that doesn't exist yet.** Right now, no one formally owns whether LawnStarter delivers the service it promises. You'll define the standard for what a Pro should deliver, then build the agents and pipelines that measure adherence to it and run the tests that change behaviors and outcomes in the field.

**Move metrics.** Leverage systems thinking and AI expertise to drive business results that sit across various functional teams. That means untangling handoffs where several teams touch a problem or goal and no one team owns the outcome.

**Take unscoped problems from ideas to fully-running and automated systems.** Some of the most important work here hasn't been named yet. At some point, someone will raise a fuzzy, unframed problem and say it needs attention. Your job is to take that starting point and build whatever tooling or process it needs, at record speed, and hand back something that runs, with a clear owner and quantitative targets attached.

**What Success Looks Like (Year 1)**

* Service Delivery is a working function with a defined (and elevated) service standard, a way to measure adherence to it, clear SOPs, and an intervention and incentive playbook that's been tested and proven to lift results.
* At least one project nobody had scoped a year earlier has gone from "we should look into this" to a heavily-automated, running system with a named owner and tracked KPIs.
* Tools you built with AI are in daily use by people other than you, and the way you work has raised the bar for how the company uses AI.
* The COO can hand you a gray-area problem with no playbook and trust that what comes back is data, a recommendation, and a plan to execute it.

 
**Requirements**

**Who You Are**

**An elite AI builder.** You think in terms of agentic systems. Building agents, evals, context engineering, and thinking in guardrails are core to who you are. You keep up with the frontier and put new capabilities to work within days, not quarters. You'd be in the top few percent of AI users at any company you've worked at. Someone who treats AI as an occasional assistant, or needs an engineer to build tooling for them, isn't the right fit here.

**A zero-to-one operator.** You've taken ambiguous, cross-team operating problems from zero to running systems as an individual contributor, with no team to hand the work to. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your experience stops at executing a scope someone else already defined.

**Marketplace-tested.** You've operated inside a marketplace or another multi-sided business and felt firsthand what it takes to balance the needs of different stakeholders on the supply and demand sides. A background built entirely on single-sided businesses, with one stakeholder type to satisfy, won't translate here.

**A finisher.** Executing what you recommend matters as much to you as the recommendation itself. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you treat strategy as your job and execution as someone else's.

**A partner who can help drive strategy collaboratively.** You work well with people who don't report to you and are a savvy cross-departmental collaborator on priorities and sequencing. If you need formal authority to effect change, this role isn't for you.

**Data-driven by reflex.** You'd rather build the query or the dashboard than argue from a hunch. This is unlikely to be a good fit if, when ambiguity hits, your first move is to guess and move on instead of digging for the number.

**At home in unresolved ambiguity.** Scope shifts as priorities do, and problems arrive unframed more often than not. That's the norm here, not an exception.

**Degree** in analytics, business or related field, with **7+ years of experience** in marketplace operations or equivalent roles.

**This Role Is NOT**

* **A people-management role.** There's no team to build or manage, at least not to start.
* **A strategy-only seat.** You'll execute what you recommend, not hand it off to someone else to run.
* **A fit for anyone who isn't already an elite AI builder.** The AI bar on this team isn't aspirational; it's the baseline we hire against.

 
**Benefits**

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Base salary**: $175,000 to $200,000.
* **Equity component**: We want the person who takes this role invested in LawnStarter delivering excellent service, and in how far AI-first operating carries this company.
* **Healthcare**: Medical, dental, and vision.
* **Fully remote (US)**: All of LawnStarter is remote. This role demands deep independent work and close partnership across a distributed, multi-country team.
* **Flexible time off**: We focus on results. Take what you need.

*LawnStarter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. We comply with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment.*

card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies' core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

This role is part of our Space and Launch business, which has contributed to the nation's space programs for decades by delivering complete solutions from concept to flight. We enable successful space operations with mission-critical technology supporting every step from first launch to final landing, including launch vehicle subsystems, propulsion systems, aerodynamic and interstage systems, and payload protection and deployment. Our high-performance solutions are engineered to operate in the most extreme environments and meet precise mission requirements.

Lead manufacturing operations across Karman's El Monte and Corona locations, aligning machining, fabrication, and downstream processing with business objectives. In this role, you will drive safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and profitability by providing operational leadership, strengthening cross-functional collaboration, and advancing continuous improvement initiatives across complex manufacturing environments.

**Responsibilities**

* Leads and coordinates manufacturing operations across the El Monte and Corona locations, establishing accountability, performance expectations, and operating rhythms for operations managers and functional departments.
* Develops and executes operational plans that align production performance, capacity, and investment priorities with company strategy.
* Oversees machining, fabrication, forming, finishing, and assembly operations to improve throughput, schedule attainment, labor productivity, and profitability.
* Drives operational excellence by implementing procedures and standards that improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and regulatory compliance.
* Champions Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement through 5S, Kaizen, flow and lead-time improvements, cycle-time and setup reduction, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), and preventative maintenance.
* Analyzes financial and production data, including overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), spindle utilization, and labor efficiency, to manage budgets, inventory, spending, and cost performance.
* Ensures equipment readiness, maintenance execution, and manufacturing capacity align with production requirements.
* Partners with human resources on workforce planning, recruiting, organizational structure, labor utilization, work scheduling, leadership development, performance evaluation, and succession planning.
* Coordinates closed-loop communication and escalation across operations, engineering, quality, supply chain, and program management.
* Manages the administration and performance of subcontracted and temporary labor services.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations management, manufacturing, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience that includes a minimum of 10 years of relevant manufacturing leadership experience.
* At least 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including oversight of complex production environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master of Business Administration (MBA), Master of Science (MS), or another advanced degree.
* Operational leadership experience in precision manufacturing supporting aerospace or defense production.
* Leadership experience in a computer numerical control (CNC) machining environment producing large, tight-tolerance metallic components.
* Experience machining aluminum using 3-axis and 5-axis milling and large gantry equipment.
* Experience with automated or semi-automated manufacturing equipment.
* Experience managing multi-step manufacturing routings and complex production flows.
* Working knowledge of deburring, finishing, forming, welding coordination, heat treatment, and assembly operations.
* Experience building high-performance manufacturing teams and leading Lean transformation.

**Physical Requirements**

* Frequently sits, uses a computer, and communicates.
* Occasionally stands, walks, reaches, or stoops.
* Uses close vision and works with screens for extended periods.
* The essential functions of this position must be performed with or without reasonable accommodation.

This position requires U.S. person status under U.S. export control laws, including U.S. citizens and nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contribution
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Company‑paid life and AD&D insurance
* Short‑ and long‑term disability coverage
* Tuition reimbursement

Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

card.title: Director of Insurance Operations
card.description:
**Foundation Risk Partners****, one of the fastest growing insurance brokerage and consulting firms in the US, is adding a** ***Director of Operations-Insurance*** **to their team in** ***Lakeland, FL.***

**Job Summary:**

The Commercial Lines Operations Leader is responsible for overseeing the operational effectiveness, service delivery, and strategic execution of commercial lines insurance processes. This role ensures alignment with business goals, regulatory compliance, and a high standard of customer and broker satisfaction. The leader will drive continuous improvement, operational efficiency, and team performance across underwriting support, policy servicing, and client onboarding.

**Essential Functions:**

* **Operational Leadership:** 
 Lead day-to-day operations for commercial lines, ensuring timely and accurate processing of policies, endorsements, renewals, and cancellations.
* **Process Optimization:** 
 Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of operations.
* **Team Management:** 
 Manage and develop a high-performing team, including training, performance management, and career development.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Partner with underwriting, claims, IT, compliance, and sales teams to ensure seamless service delivery and operational alignment.
* **Technology & Automation:** 
 Leverage technology and automation tools to streamline workflows and reduce manual tasks.
* **Compliance & Risk Management:** 
 Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, internal controls, and company policies.
* **Reporting & Analytics:** 
 Monitor KPIs, service levels, and operational metrics to drive data-informed decisions and continuous improvement.
* **Customer Experience:** 
 Champion a customer-first mindset, ensuring high service standards for brokers, agents, and policyholders.

**Competencies & Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of experience in insurance operations
* Proven leadership experience managing teams and driving operational excellence
* Strong knowledge of insurance products, systems, and regulatory environment
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Change management and process improvement expertise

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Insurance, or related field preferred
* Experience with insurance platforms (e.g. Applied Epic)
 

**Disclaimer:**

While this job description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the job requirements, management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties from particular jobs and to assign other duties as necessary.

**Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO):**

FRP provides equal employment opportunity to qualified persons regardless of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other classifications protected by law.

**Benefits:**

FRP offers a comprehensive range of health-related benefit options including medical, vision, and dental. We offer a 401(k) with company match, company paid life insurance, STD, LTD and a generous PTO policy starting at 18 days per year plus 10 paid holidays & 2 floating holidays!

card.title: Managing Director, Academic Program Operations
card.description:
**About Achievement First**

Achievement First (AF) is a non-profit 501(c)(3) organization that currently supports 41 public charter schools in New York, Connecticut, and Rhode Island. Consistently rated as one of the top charter school networks in the country for almost 25 years, AF is committed to continuous improvement, programmatic evolution for enhanced student outcomes, and sustainable growth. The majority of AF students are Black and Latinx children from low-income families who will be the first in their families to graduate from college. AF currently employs more than 2,200 staff — 64% of whom identify as Black, Indigenous, and People of Color — who collectively educate nearly 15,000 students in Brooklyn and Queens, NY; New Haven, Bridgeport, and Hartford, CT; and Providence, RI.

The mission of Achievement First is to deliver on the promise of equal educational opportunity for all of America's children. AF knows that every child—regardless of race, zip code, or economic status—deserves access to great schools. At AF, students realize their potential and develop the skills they need to graduate from high school, succeed in college, thrive in a competitive world, and serve as the next generation of leaders in their communities. At AF, students and staff embark on a shared journey to fulfill their incredible potential.

 

*We are looking for a* Managing Director of Academic Program Operations *to join our Academic Strategy & Execution team.*

**Your Impact**

The Managing Director of Academic Program Operations will serve as a senior strategic partner and operations expert working with the Academic Program Team to deliver on the implementation of Achievement First's school model & instructional priorities. This role is ideal for someone who has a deep knowledge of schools both as instructional institutions but also the intersection with funding, finance, operations, and talent practices. The Managing Director of of Academic Program Operations will partner with the Deputy Chief of Academic Strategy & Execution and other senior program leaders to deliver on a cohesive & coherent experience of our school model and support the change management involved in refining our model to align to our aims for our Achievement First graduates anchored in knowledge of self & community, college, career, & life readiness, and purpose & leadership. The Managing Director of Academic Program Operations does not need to be the content expert in any given domain, but should be a fast learner able to bring people together to solve challenges & inspire change, and be able to communicate across a variety of stakeholders including school leaders & school based staff, as well as leaders of functional teams in the organization.

*Reporting directly to the Deputy Chief of Academic Strategy & Execution you will be responsible for:*

* Managing the implementation of our current school design and instructional priorities
* + Run the project-to-operations transition gate for school design changes. Accept finished projects into standing ownership only once standard work, calendars, budget, reporting, and escalation paths are in place.
 + Set service levels for each recurring function and run an annual improvement cycle that names what to automate, transition, or outsource.
 + Manage vendor and contract relationships for recurring academic infrastructure, including renewals and performance against agreed terms.
 + Lead the Academic Operations portion of the work and talent review: inventory current work, classify it as keep, stop, or transfer, and match people to defined roles.
 + Oversee the annual planning, operations actions and execution needed across curriculum, assessment, professional learning operations, school budget development, calendar and the operations behind our instructional priorities needed to deliver our current model and priorities with excellence
 + Partner with Deputy Chiefs of School Design, and senior Academic Program leads to operationalizing our current design, recommend operational decisions for the following year and execute once decided around current policies and strategies.
 + Organize the Academic Operations team around needed capabilities and organizational impact
 + Manage Academic Operations team budget and set up monitoring systems to ensure accurate monthly forecasting each month
 + Manage a team of 4-6 direct reports who support implementation, decision making and execution of our current model.

* Drive excellence and improvement across all Academic Program infrastructure and operations
* + Curriculum and materials: Own purchasing, publication, distribution, and materials planning for network curriculum, so every classroom has what it needs before the first day of school.
 + Assessment: Run administration of state, College Board, and internal assessments, including testing windows, platforms, compliance, audits, and score reporting. Maintain the network assessment calendar. Identify which steps can be automated or outsourced to free up team capacity.
 + Professional learning: Oversee the operations behind summer and school year PD. This covers calendars, venues, registration, materials, logistics, and completion tracking. Partner with the content owners who design each training.

* Define distinct recurring academic operating functions from school management related services
* + Publish and maintain a scope map for Academic Operations and School Management Services that names what each team owns and partners on, with RAPID roles for shared decisions.
 + Own the network-level version of recurring infrastructure: academic calendar, assessment windows, materials timelines, and PD calendars.
 + Build one intake path for school and regional requests.
 + Hold the regional support work currently carried by current team until the School Management Services defined then hand it off with documented standard work.
 + Review the boundary twice a year. Track misrouted or duplicated work and move it to its right home before either team turns into a catch-all.

* Strategic Leadership, Annual Planning and Cross-Functional Operations Management (yearly & ad-hoc)
* + Set clear standards of excellence for each function, performance manage, and build specialized expertise on the team.
 + In partnership with senior project managers, oversee and manage a cohesive approach to planning for the upcoming school year each year. Deliverables include school regional calendars, comprehensive network policies/consistent practices for schools and serving as a gatekeeper on recurring academic tasks and events added to the school calendar.
 + Serve as a key thought partner to senior leaders to ensure efficiency, effectiveness and optimal use of all available resources and personnel across program teams.
 + Strategize with senior leaders on academic policy development and problem resolution; ensure implementation plans are effectively communicated and managed.

Additionally, this role will support the work of the team with ad hoc needs, including building operational documents, peer review of detailed resources, data entry, etc.

**Candidate Profile**

All candidates for this position will have a bachelor's degree and 2+ years of experience managing managers and leading complex, recurring operations across multiple stakeholders. An ideal candidate will have 2+ years of successful teaching experience, and/or a background in school operations or school leadership. There is a preference for candidates based in the regions where our schools are located (New York, Connecticut, and Rhode Island). The successful candidate must commit to being on-site in New York, Connecticut, and/or Rhode Island during July and August.

*In addition, the following characteristics are required to be successful on this team:*

* Track record of managing managers: setting clear standards of excellence, giving direct and timely feedback, and building specialized expertise on a team
* Judges success by results for schools. Willing to stop, automate, or outsource work that isn't producing them
* Owns problems through to resolution, works with peers before escalating, and brings escalations with options and a recommendation attached
* Acts on what the work needs without waiting to be asked, and brings a clear point of view when a decision sits above the role
* Experience building and running recurring operations at scale, including standard work, service levels, annual planning calendars, and continuous improvement
* Experience managing a department budget with accurate monthly forecasting, plus vendor and contract management
* Experience running large, multi-site training events and logistics
* Comfort with assessment and data platforms, and the ability to turn operational data into clear reporting
* Experience leading a team through organizational change, including role changes and new ways of working
* Confident in interacting with and influencing individuals at all levels, including state departments of education and external partners
* Exceptional eye for detail, follow-up, and organization
* Excellent verbal and written communication, with the ability to explain complex ideas simply
* Belief in the Achievement First mission and educational model

**Travel Expectations**

This is a hybrid role. The expectation is that the person in the role would be able to come into the Network Support office (NYC, CT, or RI) at least three times a week. There may be additional travel to regions outside of your own on a monthly basis.

**Compensation** 
Achievement First sets salaries through a lens of equity, based on the skills, education, and experience the role requires. The salary range for this position is $150,331 to $183,002. We place new hires within this range based on their years of experience in a comparable position, using the same criteria for every candidate. Most new hires should expect an offer at or below the midpoint of the range ($166,667). Additionally, Achievement First offers all regular, full-time employees a comprehensive benefits package that includes paid time off, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, a 403(b) retirement plan with match, and paid Family Leave.

*Achievement First is an equal opportunity employer and an organization that values diversity. People from all diverse backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply. Spanish language proficiency is a plus. You can learn more about diversity at Achievement First here:* *http://achievementfirst.org/about-us/diversity/*

**About Achievement First**

Achievement First (AF) is a non-profit 501(c)(3) organization that currently supports 41 public charter schools in New York, Connecticut, and Rhode Island. Consistently rated as one of the top charter school networks in the country for almost 25 years, AF is committed to continuous improvement, programmatic evolution for enhanced student outcomes, and sustainable growth. The majority of AF students are Black and Latinx children from low-income families who will be the first in their families to graduate from college. AF currently employs more than 2,200 staff — 64% of whom identify as Black, Indigenous, and People of Color — who collectively educate nearly 15,000 students in Brooklyn and Queens, NY; New Haven, Bridgeport, and Hartford, CT; and Providence, RI.

The mission of Achievement First is to deliver on the promise of equal educational opportunity for all of America's children. AF knows that every child—regardless of race, zip code, or economic status—deserves access to great schools. At AF, students realize their potential and develop the skills they need to graduate from high school, succeed in college, thrive in a competitive world, and serve as the next generation of leaders in their communities. At AF, students and staff embark on a shared journey to fulfill their incredible potential.

 

*We are looking for a* Managing Director of Academic Program Operations *to join our Academic Strategy & Execution team.*

The Managing Director of Academic Program Operations will serve as a senior strategic partner and operations expert working with the Academic Program Team to deliver on the implementation of Achievement First's school model & instructional priorities. The Managing Director of Academic Program Operations does not need to be the content expert in any given domain, but should be a fast learner able to bring people together to solve challenges & inspire change, and be able to communicate across a variety of stakeholders including school leaders & school based staff, as well as leaders of functional teams in the organization.

card.title: Director - Service Operations
card.description:
As the **Director of Service Operations** at Lumos, you'll play a critical leadership role in delivering reliable fiber connectivity and an exceptional customer experience across our growing markets. You'll lead and develop regional operations teams, oversee service installations and maintenance, and drive the performance, safety, and efficiency of our field operations.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact as Lumos continues to expand, combining strategic leadership with hands-on operational expertise to strengthen service delivery, improve processes, and build high-performing teams that support our customers and continued growth.

This is a remote position supporting Service Operations across the Midwest region, with a preference for candidates located within a Lumos market in **Ohio, Indiana, or Kentucky**. Regional travel is required.

**Why Lumos:**

Lumos is transforming the future of connectivity by building one of the nation's fastest-growing 100% Fiber Optic networks. Through T-Fiber, our joint venture with T-Mobile, we're working toward a shared goal of connecting 12 to 15 million homes by 2030 while expanding access to reliable, high-speed internet in the communities we serve.

Here, you'll find more than a job, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, take ownership of your work, and help shape how we grow. We move quickly, collaborate across teams, and believe the best ideas come from people who are curious, solutions-oriented, and ready to build what's next.

**What You'll Do:**

* Lead, coach, and develop regional Service Operations managers and teams, fostering accountability, collaboration, and a strong customer-first culture.
* Oversee service installations, maintenance, and field operations across assigned markets, ensuring consistent quality, safety, and operational performance.
* Establish and monitor KPIs, SLAs, and customer experience metrics to drive efficiency, service reliability, and continuous improvement.
* Develop and execute operational strategies that support market expansion, service delivery objectives, and long-term business growth.
* Manage department budgets, resources, and operational projects to ensure effective planning, execution, and cost management.
* Oversee vendor and contractor performance, including negotiations, service expectations, and accountability for operational results.
* Serve as a key escalation point for complex customer and operational challenges, driving timely resolution and improvements to the customer experience.
* Partner across Network Operations, Engineering, Construction, Customer Care, and other teams to improve workflows, strengthen service delivery, and support business objectives.
* Establish and maintain operational policies, procedures, and safety standards while identifying opportunities to improve processes and scale operations.

**What You'll Bring:**

* 7+ years of experience in telecommunications service operations, field operations, or a related area.
* Proven experience leading geographically dispersed teams, developing managers, and driving operational performance across multiple markets.
* Strong understanding of telecommunications service installation, maintenance, network operations, and customer service delivery.
* Experience managing operational budgets, vendor relationships, contractor performance, and service-level agreements.
* Ability to analyze KPIs, operational performance, and customer satisfaction metrics to identify trends and drive improvements.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and operational software platforms, with the ability to adapt to new systems and technologies.
* A proactive, solutions-oriented approach with the ability to work independently and lead effectively in a fast-paced environment.

**What Makes You a Great Fit:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Bachelor's degree in business, telecommunications, engineering, or a related field.
* Direct experience in the fiber broadband or FTTH industry, including distributed and centralized split network architectures.
* Knowledge of central office infrastructure, network equipment, and telecommunications facilities.
* Experience improving customer satisfaction, NPS scores, and operational efficiency across multiple markets.
* A track record of developing high-performing teams, improving operational processes, and supporting growth in a scaling organization.
* A collaborative, hands-on leadership style with the ability to balance strategic priorities with day-to-day operational execution.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Frequently operates a computer, phone, and standard office tools.
* Ability to travel to properties and regional offices as needed.
* Near-constant use of sight, speech, hearing, comprehension, and reasoning.
* Must be able to sit or remain in a stationary position for extended periods.

**Benefits & Perks:**

Our commitment to communities includes recruiting and rewarding the Lumos team members who are working together to build a brighter tomorrow.

We have:

* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
* Competitive compensation packages, including bonus options for eligible positions.
* Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays.
* Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs).
* 100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with access to professional support for life's challenges.
* 401K plan w/ up to 5% employer contribution and a self-directed brokerage option.
* Wellness program offering education and cash incentives for gym attendance and nutrition programs.
* Employee referral bonuses.
* Discounts on Lumos Fiber Internet for employees who live in our service areas.
* Discounts on T-Mobile wireless service and select features for lines.

**Applicant Eligibility Notice:** 
Applicants must be at least eighteen (18) years of age at the time of application.

**At Lumos we recruit, hire, employ, train, promote, and compensate individuals based on job-related qualifications and abilities. We have a longstanding policy of providing a work environment that respects the dignity and worth of each individual and is free from all forms of employment discrimination, including harassment, because of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We will provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals** **with disabilities or based on a sincerely held religious belief, in accordance with applicable laws.**

card.title: Director of Operations – Fire & Life Safety (FLS)
card.description:
The Director of Operations - Fire & Life Safety (FLS), is responsible for providing operational leadership, governance, and support across Bosch Building Technologies North America (Bosch BT NA) FLS projects & branch operations. Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Operations, this role partners closely with Branch Managers, Operations Managers, and Project Teams to drive consistent project execution, improve forecast accuracy, reduce operational risk, and strengthen financial performance.

The Director of Operations - Fire & Life Safety serves as a strategic operational leader focused on project health, resource optimization, excellence, and continuous improvement across the FLS business. The role ensures alignment to company standards and operational best practices while supporting branch teams in delivering successful outcomes for customers and stakeholders.

**Responsibilities:**

**Operational Leadership & Branch Support**

* Partner with Branch Managers and Operations Leaders to support execution of business objectives.
* Conduct regular branch operational reviews to evaluate project health, financial performance, staffing, backlog, and forecast accuracy.
* Provide leadership and guidance for complex operational issues and escalated project concerns.
* Support organizational consistency across all FLS operations.

**Project Governance & Risk Management**

* Oversee project review programs throughout the project lifecycle.
* Identify operational, contractual, financial, and execution risks on large projects.
* Facilitate risk mitigation strategies and recovery planning.
* Support margin improvement initiatives and reduction of project deviations.
* Ensure project controls and governance standards are consistently followed.
* Drive consistent execution standards across all FLS operations.

**Financial & Operational Performance**

* Review project forecasts, earned revenue, gross margin performance, labor utilization, and backlog health.
* Partner with branch leadership on annual planning, budgeting, and forecasting activities.
* Drive accountability for operational KPIs and project financial performance.
* Improve forecast accuracy and operational predictability

**Process Standardization & Continuous Improvement**

* Implement operational best practices and playbooks.
* Support standardization of project execution methodologies.
* Identify opportunities for productivity improvements and workflow efficiencies.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives across assigned branches.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Engineering, Sales, Procurement, Service, and Finance teams.
* Support seamless project transitions from sales through execution and into service.
* Ensure operational alignment with strategic organizational objectives.

**Health, Safety & Compliance**

* Promote a culture of operational excellence and safety.
* Ensure compliance with customer requirements, company policies, and regulatory standards.

**Supervisor Duties:**

In accordance with applicable Company policies/procedures and Federal/State laws, will perform the following supervisory responsibilities: planning, assigning, and directing work; coaching and appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**Professional Competencies:**

* Resilience: Ability to maintain composure and adapt swiftly amidst uncertainty and rapid changes.
* Strategic Agility: Capacity to analyze situations critically and make prompt, well-informed decisions, considering diverse scenarios and potential outcomes.
* Entrepreneurial Mindset: Willingness to take calculated risks and explore innovative solutions to drive growth and capitalize on opportunities.
* Collaborative Leadership: Skill in fostering collaboration and teamwork across diverse stakeholders and departments to achieve common objectives.
* Resourcefulness: Ability to effectively leverage available resources, networks, and expertise to address challenges and capitalize on synergies.
* Attention to Detail: Capability to manage intricate details and nuances, ensuring thorough planning and execution of strategic initiatives.
* Emotional Intelligence: Aptitude in understanding and managing emotions to navigate sensitive situations, negotiate effectively, and build strong relationships.
* Adaptability: Willingness and ability to adjust strategies and approaches in response to evolving market dynamics, regulatory requirements, or unexpected developments.
* Clear Communication: Strong communication skills to articulate complex ideas, influence stakeholders, and navigate challenging conversations.
* Ethical Integrity: Commitment to upholding high ethical standards and integrity, ensuring transparency and compliance with regulations and corporate governance principles.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 8 - 10 years of leadership experience within Fire & Life Safety operations, project management, or construction operations.
* Strong working knowledge of Fire & Life Safety systems, including fire alarm, detection, notification, emergency communications, and building-system interfaces, with strong understanding of applicable NFPA, NEC, IBC/IFC, and UL codes and requirements.
* Proven experience managing large project portfolios.
* Expertise in forecasting, financial management, project controls, and operational leadership.
* Experience with ERP and project management platforms.
* A valid Driver's License and ability to pass pre-employment screens

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business, or equivalent experience
* Previous and progressive experience in Operational leadership within Building Automation Systems projects & programs
* Experience developing and implementing national operational standards, including SOPs, domain specific operational playbooks, and process guidelines
* Ability to collaborate cross functionally with Engineering, Sales, Procurement, Service, and Finance teams to drive operation initiatives
* Harmonization of Operations Department through Merger & Acquisition activity
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or similar ERP platforms

**Key Success Metrics:**

* Project Margin Performance
* Forecast Accuracy
* Gross Margin Performance
* Schedule Adherence
* Labor Productivity
* Risk Reduction
* Backlog Health
* Customer Satisfaction
* Safety Performance

**Physical Demands:**

In general, the following physical demands are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job.

* Must be able to effectively communicate in English, (ie see, hear, speak and write clearly) in order to communicate with colleagues and/or customers
* Manual dexterity required for occasional reaching, lifting of light office objects, and operating office equipment
* Sitting, standing, walking in office environments and construction sites
* The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and may be required to work at heights over 1.8m (6 feet)

**Working Conditions:**

In general, the following conditions of the work environment are representative of those that an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

* The office is clean, orderly, properly lighted and ventilated. Noise levels are considered low to moderate
* Will be required to be on site with customers or contractors, with or without colleagues to manage the expectations and deliverables. Sites range from general office environments to new construction.
* Driving to customer sites is required
* Overnight travel will be required

**Additional Information:**

* **Compensation:** $165,000 - $225,000 + 20% Annual Bonus (DOE)
* **Working Hours:** This position generally works Monday - Friday, overtime and on call when necessary
* **Travel Requirements:** 35-50%
* **Bosch Discounts:** As an associate of Bosch, you will have access to various discount programs
* **Benefits:**
 + Medical
 + Dental
 + Vision
 + Flexible Spending Accounts
 + 401K w/ company match
 + Life/AD&D/LTD
 + Paid Vacation/Sick/Holidays
 + Employee Assistance Program
 + Pet Insurance

Requirements:

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** 
This company considers candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability unrelated to ability, marital status, family responsibilities, pregnancy, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity, transgender, sex stereotyping, order of protection status, protected veteran or military status, or an unfavorable discharge from military service, and other categories protected by federal, state or local law.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

**U.S. and Canada Privacy Notice**

United States and Canada residents have the right to receive additional notices about their personal information. To learn more, click here.

**French Privacy Notice** 
French Canadian residents have the right to receive additional notices about their personal information. To learn more, click here. 
 
**Reasonable Accommodations** 
If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing a job application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, you can reach out to our HR team for support at AskHR.BT-NA@bosch.com. Please note our HR representatives do not have visibility of application or interview status. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job

***Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only. Future sponsorship is unavailable. U.S. work authorized individuals only.***

card.title: Regional Director Operations-RD
card.description:
The Regional Director of Operations is responsible for providing operational leadership, client partnership support, and strategic oversight for multiple senior living dining and hospitality accounts within an assigned region. This position partners closely with community leadership teams, culinary operations, resident experience teams, and corporate leadership to ensure operational excellence, financial performance, hospitality culture, regulatory compliance, and elevated resident satisfaction across all assigned communities.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is an exempt salaried position, with expected hours to include: days, evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Essential Functions and Duties

Operational Leadership

* Provide leadership and operational oversight for multiple senior living dining and hospitality accounts
* Support and mentor Directors of Dining Services, Executive Chefs, Resident Experience leaders, and community management teams
* Ensure operational consistency, hospitality standards, and service excellence throughout all assigned communities
* Conduct regular operational visits, audits, and performance reviews

Client & Resident Relationships

* Build and maintain strong relationships with client leadership teams, residents, families, and operational partners
* Ensure resident satisfaction initiatives and hospitality-focused service culture remain a top operational priority
* Participate in client meetings, operational reviews, and strategic planning discussions
* Address operational concerns and support service recovery initiatives when needed

Financial Management

* Manage regional financial performance including:

* labor management,
* food cost controls,
* budgeting,
* forecasting,
* and overall account profitability

* Analyze financial reports and operational metrics to identify opportunities for improvement
* Support implementation of operational efficiencies and cost-control initiatives

Culinary & Hospitality Excellence

* Support culinary innovation, menu development, dining presentation, and hospitality-driven service initiatives
* Ensure dining environments reflect company hospitality standards and resident experience expectations
* Promote elevated dining experiences throughout all communities

Associate Leadership & Development

* Recruit, coach, mentor, and develop operational leadership teams
* Support associate engagement, retention, succession planning, and performance management initiatives
* Foster a positive, professional, and accountability-driven culture throughout the region

record.ROLE_TEXT:
The Regional Director of Operations is responsible for providing operational leadership, client partnership support, and strategic oversight for multiple senior living dining and hospitality accounts within an assigned region. This position partners closely with community leadership teams, culinary operations, resident experience teams, and corporate leadership to ensure operational excellence, financial performance, hospitality culture, regulatory compliance, and elevated resident satisfaction across all assigned communities.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is an exempt salaried position, with expected hours to include: days, evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Essential Functions and Duties

Operational Leadership

* Provide leadership and operational oversight for multiple senior living dining and hospitality accounts
* Support and mentor Directors of Dining Services, Executive Chefs, Resident Experience leaders, and community management teams
* Ensure operational consistency, hospitality standards, and service excellence throughout all assigned communities
* Conduct regular operational visits, audits, and performance reviews

Client & Resident Relationships

* Build and maintain strong relationships with client leadership teams, residents, families, and operational partners
* Ensure resident satisfaction initiatives and hospitality-focused service culture remain a top operational priority
* Participate in client meetings, operational reviews, and strategic planning discussions
* Address operational concerns and support service recovery initiatives when needed

Financial Management

* Manage regional financial performance including:

* labor management,
* food cost controls,
* budgeting,
* forecasting,
* and overall account profitability

* Analyze financial reports and operational metrics to identify opportunities for improvement
* Support implementation of operational efficiencies and cost-control initiatives

Culinary & Hospitality Excellence

* Support culinary innovation, menu development, dining presentation, and hospitality-driven service initiatives
* Ensure dining environments reflect company hospitality standards and resident experience expectations
* Promote elevated dining experiences throughout all communities

Associate Leadership & Development

* Recruit, coach, mentor, and develop operational leadership teams
* Support associate engagement, retention, succession planning, and performance management initiatives
* Foster a positive, professional, and accountability-driven culture throughout the region
* Assist with onboarding and transition support for new business and leadership changes

Compliance & Quality Assurance

* Ensure compliance with all federal, state, local, and company regulations and standards
* Support sanitation, food safety, healthcare compliance, and regulatory audit readiness
* Conduct operational assessments and quality assurance reviews
